name: Rituximab (single agent, NLPHL)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Infusion-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Premedicate with acetaminophen and an antihistamine (and consider a corticosteroid) before rituximab to reduce infusion reactions; screen hepatitis B before anti-CD20 therapy.

supportiveCare: Anti-CD20 monotherapy option for CD20-positive nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (low-burden or asymptomatic disease).
Hepatitis B reactivation risk: screen and provide antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive or core-antibody-positive patients.
Weekly induction schedule (4 doses); maintenance schedules may be considered separately.
monitoring: monitor for infusion reactions during administration

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.notes: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV weekly on days 1, 8, 15, and 22 (4-dose induction). Premedicate for infusion reactions; screen hepatitis B. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
